name: f-studio
prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot. The woman slides two fingers on the trackpad, tilts her head slightly while reading the table on the screen, then nods to herself. Gentle handheld drift toward the laptop, afternoon light. The laptop screen content stays exactly as it is: sharp, still and unchanged. Realistic, natural motion, no text overlays, no logos.

name: f-founder
prompt: He talks straight to the camera in a relaxed, warm voice with natural pauses and small hand gestures, realistic lip sync: "I ask AI a hundred small things a day. Every one used to mean a new tab, and losing my place. So Flare lives one shortcut away. Command, Shift, Space. Ask. Done. And your chats never leave your Mac." He smiles at the end. Quiet room tone, no music. Golden hour loft, subtle handheld, no text, no logos.
